subject: IRACE in batchmode on cluster using HTCondor?

messages.author: 474e4d3c760f96a5
messages.subject: IRACE in batchmode on cluster using HTCondor?
parts:
Hi all,
I have access to a cluster using HTCondor as job scheduler. Does IRACE support batchmode for HTCondor? If not, would it be possible to adapt one of the example scripts for this scheduler?

messages.author: 854a0709976c2a48
messages.subject: Re: IRACE in batchmode on cluster using HTCondor?
parts:
Hi Filippo,

It depends what you mean by "support" and "batchmode".

If you mean irace is submitted as a job, then surely yes as there is nothing special about irace in this regard, it will be submitted as any other multi-core or MPI job.

If you mean that irace sits in the submission node and submits jobs asynchronously (this is what irace means by "batchmode", i.e., option 3 in Section 6 of the user guide: https://mlopez-ibanez.github.io/irace/irace-package.pdf), then the answer is not yet as that requires special support code in R/cluster.R (mostly to tell irace how to identify jobs and track their status). If you look at the examples in that file, it should be more or less easy to figure out what you need to add. We are happy to accept a patch/pull request: https://github.com/MLopez-Ibanez/irace

Another possibility is to use option 4 (same Section 6) and write a custom targetRunnerParallel() function, perhaps using additional R packages to help you submit jobs and track their status.

I wonder if there is anyone else in this list who has access to HTCondor and has used irace with it?

Best,

Manuel.
